title: Organically
description: This mod adds features that organically fit into the world of minecraft, such as new plants, mobs and equipment.
body:
## Organically Mod - by Eravern


the mod adds new blocks, items, mobs and features to the world, future planned content includes new structures, new additions to old systems, a FD addon and even a possible boss fight.


NEW CONTENT:

- Palm Wood Set:
  
  deriving from the new palm tree, found in beaches

- palm tree and coconuts:

  palm trees are found in beaches, they grow coconuts from the top of their trunks, which can be 
  harvested when mature, placed down for decoration, placed on sand to have them grow into
  sprouted coconuts (the tree's saplings), or split using an axe, to obtain coconut slices, the
  palm crown, found at the top of the tree and the part that grows coconuts, can be sheared into
  a palm log to obtain palm salad, coconut slices can be crafted into coconut lamps.

- sea rock stone set:

  sea rock can be found under the form of rocks, on the sea floor or the beach, or in the form
  of giant sea pillars that stretch from the bottom of the ocean to the top mollusks can also
  commonly grow on it (mollusks, alongside scallops and antarctic scallops, can be crafted into
  bone meal, fed to turtles or crafted into sea farer's chow, a new food item, alongside just
  being used decoratively), sea rock can be used to craft a new stone set, complete with
  polished variants, brick variants and chiselled variants.

- desert rose and mesa rose:

  rarely, in deserts and mesas, you may find small pillars of desert and mesa rose clusters,
  from these clusters a new material grows: desert rose, one of the rarest block sets in the 
  game, it is an essential ingredient in crafting the sandstrider boots, and can be farmed from
  naturally spawning clusters, which constantly grow clusters on them, but remember to not break 
  them, as only naturally spawning blocks can grow new clusters, and the only way to activate a
  player placed block, is by using active powder.

- fossils and trowel:

  in deserts, you can now find desert fossil formations, deep clumps of sandstone, fossil clumps
  and bones with a small part exposed to the surface, the fossil clumps can be harvested with a
  pickaxe to obtain bone meal, or with a trowel (new brushlike tool crafted with one stick, one
  copper ingot and one iron ingot), to obtain bones, uncommonly fossils and rarely a gnawer egg.

- desert plants:

  in deserts, you may now find triodia (desert grass), barrel cacti, desert marigolds and
  brittlebushes, in woodland mesas you may also find desert shaggy mane, a new mushroom, in
  savannas you may also find snake plants and saltbushes.

- new biomes:

  the mod also adds new biomes, one of which is the arid plains, which replaces plain biomes in
  warm and arid spots, it is distinguished by a much drier leaves and grass tint, along with a
  being striped by course dirt and sand.

- new mobs:

  Lionfish: new fish found in warm oceans, it drops a new food item (lionfish) and a new 
  projectile: the lionfish spike, lionfish spikes can be shot with bows and crossbows to inflict
  the electrified effect (also inflicted by the lionfish when a player bumps into it), which
  damages a mob when wet (under the rain, touching water, etc.)
  Sandstrider: new hostile mob spawning in deserts and mesas at night, it quickly charges at the 
  player and tries to bite them, when hit, they may rarely drop a sandstrider scale, used to
  craft sandstrider boots, a new armor piece crafted with sandstrider scales, rabbit hide and a 
  desert/mesa rose, it allows the player to gain speed when sprinting on sand blocks.
  Gnawer: new ancient mob deriving from gnawer eggs, it can gnaw on certain items to obtain
  other resources when it is done chewing (feeding it bones will yield slime balls or
  fluorescent mucus, feeding it fossils will yield calcium), fluorescent mucus crafts into a new
  fluorescent mucus block, which glows when touched, also giving the mob the glowing effect,
  it can also smelt into glowstone or turn ink sacs into glowing ink sacs. Calcium can be used
  to craft calcite, dripstone and active powder, used to turn desert rose cluster blocks into
  active desert rose cluster blocks, which can grow new clusters, this item will be given more 
  uses in the future.
